# Lúnia Aesthetics (@lunia.aesthetics)

> Advanced Aesthetics & Skin Treatments in Bournemouth, Dorset, UK. Specialising in natural results, brow health, and evidence-based aesthetic care.

## Core Information
- Practitioner: Lúnia (Aesthetic Practitioner & BSc Biomedical Science student)
- Location: Bournemouth, Dorset, United Kingdom (serving Bournemouth, Poole, Christchurch, and surrounding Dorset areas)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lunia.aesthetics/
- Direct Booking: Instagram DM (https://ig.me/m/lunia.aesthetics) or WhatsApp
- Philosophy: Natural results, individualized clinical assessment, high hygiene standards, science-led treatments. Treatments are strictly for adults aged 18 and over.

## Core Treatments
1. **Premium Repair Brows**: Specialised follicle-support protocol and high-performance actives aimed at nurturing brow follicle health, restoring density, strengthening thinning or over-plucked brows, and promoting natural hair quality.
2. **Brow Lamination**: Precision brow realignment and discipline for full, brushed-up, and defined natural eyebrows.
3. **Lip Filler / Preenchimento Labial**: Subtle, proportion-focused hyaluronic enhancement tailored to facial harmony with strict natural results discipline (18+ only).

## Booking Process
Every treatment begins with a thorough bespoke assessment. Pricing is confirmed during consultation based on individual anatomy and goals.
